test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The government is implementing new policies to reduce pollution in the city.

options.text: New policies are being implemented by the government to reduce pollution in the city.
The government implemented new policies to reduce pollution in the city.
The implementation of new policies to reduce pollution in the city is by the government.
The government will implement new policies to reduce pollution in the city.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **Present Continuous Tense** and Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Present Continuous Tense from Active voice to Passive voice:
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.​
 
• Structure:
 
 
• **Subject + am/is/are + (Verb+ing) + Object (Active Voice) **
 
• **Object + am/is/are + being+ V3 + by + Subject (Passive Voice)**
 
 
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and** "The government" **is the subject and **"new policies" **is the object.
 
• When we convert this sentence into passive voice, the subject **"The government"** of the passive voice becomes the object, and the object **"new policies" **becomes the subject.
 
• **"New policies" **is a plural subject. Hence it will take a plural verb **'are'.**
 
• The verb **"is implementing"** will change into **"are being implemented".**

Therefore, the correct passive voice is*** "New policies are being implemented by the government to reduce pollution in the city."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• In voice change, **TENSE **will never change.
 
• Be careful of the number of the object. Change the verb as per the number of the object.*** ***
